en: A vintage black-and-white postcard shows a large crowd assembled in a town square in front of a row of traditional European buildings. Military personnel stand in the foreground, and many people are gathered, including children and women in traditional dress. The windows of the buildings are filled with spectators. On the right, there is printed text in both French and English describing the event as taking place in liberated Alsace, specifically in Massevaux, with reference to American and French military presence after a review on July 4th, 1918.
